statement: FARO v0.4 spot-response index 0–10: Hs² × model mean period per swell partition; coastal-guide angular support remains influential in energetic off-axis swells. No empirical breaker-height calibration or locally derived tide/shape model.

heuristics.offAxisScoreFloorDescription: Heuristic lower bound on directional score compatibility for wave approach outside uncalibrated guide sectors, NOT a physical refraction coefficient, measured percentage or safety gate.

CL-VS:la-boca-concon.name: La Boca · Concón
CL-VS:la-boca-concon.tideReference: All tides reported by a guide; response of individual sandbanks remains uncalibrated.
CL-VS:la-boca-concon.hazardContextEs: Desembocadura con corrientes, cambios de bancos y restricciones ambientales en el humedal. No interpretar el score como autorización de acceso.
CL-VS:la-boca-concon.hazardContextEn: River mouth with currents, changing sandbanks and wetland restrictions. A score is not an access clearance.

CL-VS:ritoque.name: Ritoque · picos norte
CL-VS:ritoque.tideReference: Medium–low reported; not applied without measured local tide/bank response.
CL-VS:ritoque.hazardContextEs: La zona norte tiene canales de entrada; hacia el sur la exposición y remada cambian. Revisar bancos y corrientes.
CL-VS:ritoque.hazardContextEn: The northern zone has channels; exposure and paddling change towards the south. Check sandbanks and currents.

CL-VS:renaca.name: Reñaca · picos norte
CL-VS:renaca.tideReference: Medium–low reported for northern peaks, not an entire-beach validated tide response.
CL-VS:renaca.hazardContextEs: Las secciones norte y sur difieren; el swell puede intensificar corrientes. Verificar la rompiente.
CL-VS:renaca.hazardContextEn: Northern and southern sections differ; swell can strengthen currents. Verify the surf locally.

CL-VS:maitencillo.name: Maitencillo · perfil general
CL-VS:maitencillo.tideReference: Medium or rising suggested in guides; not modelled or calibrated by FARO.
CL-VS:maitencillo.hazardContextEs: Maitencillo incluye diferentes secciones y referencias contradictorias sobre el tipo de fondo. El índice no sustituye una lectura del pico seleccionado.
CL-VS:maitencillo.hazardContextEn: Maitencillo covers several sections and sources disagree on break type. This index cannot replace checking the actual peak.

CL-VS:papagayo-quintero.name: Papagayo · Quintero
CL-VS:papagayo-quintero.tideReference: No reliable ideal local tide reference; not modelled.

personality.en: Fast left over a rocky break

CL-VS:papagayo-quintero.hazardContextEs: Rompiente exigente sobre roca; secciones rápidas, posibles tubos y accesos específicos. Un score alto no indica que sea segura ni apropiada para tu nivel.
CL-VS:papagayo-quintero.hazardContextEn: Demanding rocky break with faster sections and specific access. A high score does not imply safety or suitability for your level.

CL-VS:ventanas.name: Ventanas · Muelle Chico / Pilotes
CL-VS:ventanas.guideAngleInterpretation: North/South cardinal labels from one community-derived text, converted to 45° compass bins (±22.5°). Hypotheses only; no demonstrated favourable angular interval or nearshore refraction model.
CL-VS:ventanas.tideReference: Community guide: all tide levels, falling tide preferred. No validated sector-specific tide or depth response. The University of Valparaíso Quintero Bay forecast is for ~20 m depth and does not resolve Pilotes or Muelle Chico breaking waves.

personality.es: Muelle Chico: izquierda y derecha descritas como accesibles; Pilotes: sección exigente. No verificados ni georreferenciados.
personality.en: Muelle Chico: community-described accessible left/right; Pilotes: demanding section. Neither independently verified nor georeferenced.

CL-VS:ventanas.hazardContextEs: Ventanas: índice experimental de potencial oceánico, NO pronóstico calibrado de rompiente ni recomendación para entrar al agua. Restricción sanitaria por fragata portuguesa reportada vigente al 27 de octubre; no se ha verificado levantamiento. Entorno industrial/portuario: verificar condiciones ambientales y restricciones marítimas.
CL-VS:ventanas.hazardContextEn: Ventanas: experimental offshore potential estimate, NOT calibrated breaking-wave forecast or water-entry recommendation. Portuguese man-of-war recreation restriction still reported on 27 October; no lifting verified. Industrial/port setting requires independent environmental and maritime access verification.
validationTargets: local filmed breaking wave type and size
